elements.name: NONE
elements.description: Erases particles.

elements.name: DUST
elements.description: Very light dust. Flammable.

elements.name: WATR
elements.description: Water. Conducts electricity, freezes, and extinguishes fires.

elements.name: OIL
elements.description: Flammable, turns into GAS at low pressure or high temperature.

elements.name: FIRE
elements.description: Ignites flammable materials. Heats air.

elements.name: STNE
elements.description: Stone. Heavy particles, meltable.

elements.name: LAVA
elements.description: Molten lava. Ignites flammable materials. Generated when metals and other materials melt, solidifies when cold.

elements.name: GUN
elements.description: Gunpowder. Light dust, explodes on contact with fire or spark.

elements.name: NITR
elements.description: Nitroglycerin. Pressure sensitive explosive. Mix with CLST to make TNT.

elements.name: CLNE
elements.description: Clone. Duplicates any particles it touches.

elements.name: GAS
elements.description: Diffuses quickly and is flammable. Liquefies into OIL under pressure.

elements.name: C-4
elements.description: Solid pressure sensitive explosive.

elements.name: GOO
elements.description: Deforms and disappears under pressure.

elements.name: ICE
elements.description: Crushes under pressure. Cools down air.

elements.name: METL
elements.description: Metal, the basic conductor. Meltable.

elements.name: SPRK
elements.description: Electricity. The basis of all electronics in TPT, travels along conductive elements.

elements.name: SNOW
elements.description: Light particles. Created when ICE breaks under pressure.

elements.name: WOOD
elements.description: Wood, flammable.

elements.name: NEUT
elements.description: Neutrons. Interact with matter in odd ways.

elements.name: PLUT
elements.description: Plutonium. Heavy, fissile particles. Generates neutrons under pressure.

elements.name: PLNT
elements.description: Plant, drinks water and grows.

elements.name: ACID
elements.description: Dissolves almost everything.

elements.name: VOID
elements.description: Hole, will drain away any particles.

elements.name: WTRV
elements.description: Steam. Produced from hot water.

elements.name: CNCT
elements.description: Concrete. Can stack on itself or ROCK, collapses with pressure.

elements.name: DSTW
elements.description: Distilled water, does not conduct electricity.

elements.name: SALT
elements.description: Salt, dissolves in water.

elements.name: SLTW
elements.description: Saltwater, conducts electricity, difficult to freeze.

elements.name: DMND
elements.description: Diamond. Indestructible.

elements.name: BMTL
elements.description: Breakable metal. Common conductive building material, can melt and break under pressure.

elements.name: BRMT
elements.description: Broken metal. Created when iron rusts or when metals break from pressure.

elements.name: PHOT
elements.description: Photons. Refract through glass, and different elements change its color. Can ignite flammable materials.

elements.name: URAN
elements.description: Uranium. Heavy particles. Generates heat under pressure.

elements.name: WAX
elements.description: Flammable, melts at moderately high temperatures.

elements.name: MWAX
elements.description: Liquid Wax. Hardens into WAX at 45 degrees.

elements.name: PSCN
elements.description: P-Type Silicon, Will transfer current to any conductor. Enables powered materials.

elements.name: NSCN
elements.description: N-Type Silicon, Will not transfer current to P-Type Silicon. Disables powered materials.

elements.name: LN2
elements.description: Liquid Nitrogen. Very cold, disappears whenever it touches anything warmer.

elements.name: INSL
elements.description: Insulator. Blocks heat, electricity, and radiation.

elements.name: VACU
elements.description: Vacuum, sucks in other particles and heats up.

elements.name: VENT
elements.description: Air vent, creates pressure and pushes other particles away.

elements.name: RBDM
elements.description: Rubidium. Explosive, especially on contact with water. Low melting point.

elements.name: LRBD
elements.description: Liquid Rubidium.

elements.name: NTCT
elements.description: NTC Thermistor. Conducts with PSCN and NSCN, but only when heated above 100C.

elements.name: SAND
elements.description: Sand, Heavy particles. Melts into glass.

elements.name: GLAS
elements.description: Glass. Meltable. Shatters under pressure, and refracts photons.

elements.name: PTCT
elements.description: PTC Thermistor. Conducts with PSCN and NSCN, but only when cooled below 100C.

elements.name: BGLA
elements.description: Broken Glass, heavy particles formed when glass breaks under pressure. Meltable. Bagels.

elements.name: THDR
elements.description: Lightning! Very hot, inflicts damage upon most materials, and transfers current to metals.

elements.name: PLSM
elements.description: Plasma, extremely hot.

elements.name: ETRD
elements.description: Electrode. Creates plasma arcs with electricity. (Use sparingly)

elements.name: NICE
elements.description: Nitrogen Ice. Very cold, will melt into LN2 when heated only slightly.

elements.name: NBLE
elements.description: Noble Gas. Ionizes into plasma when sparked. Diffuses.

elements.name: BTRY
elements.description: Battery. Generates infinite electricity.

elements.name: LCRY
elements.description: Liquid Crystal. Changes colour when charged. (PSCN Charges, NSCN Discharges)

elements.name: STKM
elements.description: Stickman. Don't kill him! Control with the arrow keys.

elements.name: SWCH
elements.description: Switch. Only conducts when switched on. (PSCN switches on, NSCN switches off)

elements.name: SMKE
elements.description: Smoke, created by fire.

elements.name: DESL
elements.description: Liquid diesel. Explodes under high pressure and temperatures.

elements.name: COAL
elements.description: Coal, Burns very slowly. Gets red when hot.

elements.name: LOXY
elements.description: Liquid Oxygen. Very cold. Reacts with fire.

elements.name: OXYG
elements.description: Oxygen gas. Ignites easily.

elements.name: INWR
elements.description: Insulated wire. Only conducts to PSCN, NSCN, WIFI, and SWCH.

elements.name: YEST
elements.description: Yeast, grows when warm (~37C).

elements.name: DYST
elements.description: Dead Yeast.

elements.name: THRM
elements.description: Thermite. Burns into extremely hot molten metal.

elements.name: GLOW
elements.description: Glow, Glows under pressure.

elements.name: BRCK
elements.description: Brick, breakable building material.

elements.name: CFLM
elements.description: Sub-zero flame.

elements.name: FIRW
elements.description: Fireworks! Colorful, set off by fire.

elements.name: FUSE
elements.description: Burns slowly. Ignites at very high temperatures or when sparked.

elements.name: FSEP
elements.description: Fuse Powder. Burns slowly like FUSE.

elements.name: AMTR
elements.description: Anti-Matter, destroys a majority of particles.

elements.name: BCOL
elements.description: Broken Coal. Heavy particles, burns slowly.

elements.name: PCLN
elements.description: Powered clone. When activated, duplicates any particles it touches.

elements.name: HSWC
elements.description: Heat switch. Conducts heat only when activated.

elements.name: IRON
elements.description: Rusts with salt, can be used for electrolysis of WATR.

elements.name: MORT
elements.description: Steam Train.

elements.name: LIFE
elements.description: Game Of Life! B3/S23

elements.name: DLAY
elements.description: Conducts with temperature-dependent delay. (use HEAT/COOL).

elements.name: CO2
elements.description: Carbon Dioxide. Heavy gas, drifts downwards. Carbonates water and turns to dry ice when cold.

elements.name: DRIC
elements.description: Dry Ice, formed when CO2 is cooled.

elements.name: BUBW
elements.description: Carbonated water. Slowly releases CO2.

elements.name: STOR
elements.description: Storage. Captures and stores a single particle. Releases when charged with PSCN, also passes to PIPE.

elements.name: PVOD
elements.description: Powered VOID. When activated, destroys entering particles.

elements.name: CONV
elements.description: Converter. Converts everything into whatever it first touches.

elements.name: CAUS
elements.description: Caustic Gas, acts like ACID.

elements.name: LIGH
elements.description: Lightning. Change the brush size to set the size of the lightning.

elements.name: TESC
elements.description: Tesla coil! Creates lightning when sparked.

elements.name: DEST
elements.description: More destructive Bomb, can break through virtually anything.

elements.name: SPNG
elements.description: Sponge, absorbs water. Is not a moving solid.

elements.name: RIME
elements.description: Solid, created when steam cools rapidly and goes through deposition, skipping the liquid phase.

elements.name: FOG
elements.description: Fog, created when an electric current is passed through RIME.

elements.name: BCLN
elements.description: Breakable Clone.

elements.name: LOVE
elements.description: Love...

elements.name: DEUT
elements.description: Deuterium oxide. Gets more concentrated when cold, explodes with neutrons or protons.

elements.name: WARP
elements.description: Displaces other elements.

elements.name: PUMP
elements.description: Pressure pump. Changes pressure to its temp when activated. (use HEAT/COOL).

elements.name: FWRK
elements.description: Original version of fireworks, activated by heat/neutrons.

elements.name: PIPE
elements.description: PIPE, moves particles around. Once the BRCK generates, erase some for the exit. Then the PIPE generates and is usable.

elements.name: FRZZ
elements.description: Freeze powder. When melted, forms ice that always cools. Spreads with regular water.

elements.name: FRZW
elements.description: Freeze water. Hybrid liquid formed when Freeze powder melts.

elements.name: GRAV
elements.description: Very light dust. Changes colour based on velocity.

elements.name: BIZR
elements.description: Bizarre... contradicts the normal state changes. Paints other elements with its deco color.

elements.name: BIZG
elements.description: Bizarre gas.

elements.name: BIZS
elements.description: Bizarre solid.

elements.name: INST
elements.description: Instantly conducts, PSCN to charge, NSCN to take.

elements.name: ISOZ
elements.description: Isotope-Z. Radioactive liquid, decays into photons when touching PHOT or under negative pressure.

elements.name: ISZS
elements.description: Solid form of ISOZ, slowly decays into PHOT.

elements.name: PRTI
elements.description: Portal IN. Particles go in here. Also has temperature dependent channels. (same as WIFI)

elements.name: PRTO
elements.description: Portal OUT. Particles come out here. Also has temperature dependent channels. (same as WIFI)

elements.name: PSTE
elements.description: Colloid, Hardens under pressure.

elements.name: PSTS
elements.description: Solid form of PSTE.

elements.name: ANAR
elements.description: Anti-air. Very light gravity-defying dust. Burns cold instead of hot.

elements.name: VINE
elements.description: Vine, can grow along WOOD.

elements.name: INVS
elements.description: Invisible under pressure, allowing particles through.

elements.name: EQVE
elements.description: A failed shared velocity test.

elements.name: SPWN2
elements.description: STK2 spawn point.

elements.name: SPWN
elements.description: STKM spawn point.

elements.name: SHLD
elements.description: Shield. Grows around spark, broken by pressure.

elements.name: SHD2
elements.description: Shield lvl 2.

elements.name: SHD3
elements.description: Shield lvl 3.

elements.name: SHD4
elements.description: Shield lvl 4.

elements.name: LOLZ
elements.description: Lolz

elements.name: WIFI
elements.description: Wireless transmitter, transfers spark to any other wifi on the same temperature channel.

elements.name: FILT
elements.description: Filter. Changes color of PHOT and BIZR. Color depends on temperature.

elements.name: ARAY
elements.description: Ray Emitter. Rays create points when they collide.

elements.name: BRAY
elements.description: Ray Point. Rays create points when they collide.

elements.name: STK2
elements.description: Second stickman. Don't kill him! Control with wasd.

elements.name: BOMB
elements.description: Bomb. Explodes and destroys all surrounding particles when it touches something.

elements.name: C-5
elements.description: Cold explosive, set off by anything cold.

elements.name: SING
elements.description: Singularity. Creates huge amounts of negative pressure and destroys everything.

elements.name: QRTZ
elements.description: Quartz, breakable mineral. Conducts but becomes brittle when cold. Scatters photons.

elements.name: PQRT
elements.description: Powdered quartz, broken form of QRTZ.

elements.name: EMP
elements.description: Electromagnetic pulse. Breaks activated electronics.

elements.name: BREL
elements.description: Broken electronics. Formed from EMP blasts, and when constantly sparked while under pressure, turns to EXOT.

elements.name: ELEC
elements.description: Electrons. Sparks electronics, reacts with NEUT and WATR.

elements.name: ACEL
elements.description: Accelerator, speeds up nearby elements.

elements.name: DCEL
elements.description: Decelerator, slows down nearby elements.

elements.name: TNT
elements.description: TNT, explodes all at once.

elements.name: IGNC
elements.description: Ignition cord. Burns slowly with fire and sparks.

elements.name: BOYL
elements.description: Boyle, variable pressure gas. Expands when heated.

elements.name: GEL
elements.description: A liquid with variable viscosity and heat conductivity. Absorbs water.

elements.name: TRON
elements.description: Smart particles, Travels in straight lines and avoids obstacles. Grows with time.

elements.name: TTAN
elements.description: Titanium. Higher melting temperature than most other metals, blocks all air pressure.

elements.name: EXOT
elements.description: Exotic matter. Explodes with excess exposure to electrons. Has many other odd reactions.

elements.name: EMBR
elements.description: Sparks. Formed by explosions.

elements.name: HYGN
elements.description: Hydrogen. Combusts with OXYG to make WATR. Undergoes fusion at high temperature and pressure.

elements.name: SOAP
elements.description: Soap. Creates bubbles, washes off deco color, and cures virus.

elements.name: BHOL
elements.description: Black hole, sucks in particles using gravity. (Requires Newtonian gravity)

elements.name: WHOL
elements.description: White hole, pushes away other particles with gravity. (Requires Newtonian gravity)

elements.name: MERC
elements.description: Mercury. Volume changes with temperature, Conductive.

elements.name: PBCN
elements.description: Powered breakable clone.

elements.name: GPMP
elements.description: Gravity pump. Changes gravity to its temp when activated. (use HEAT/COOL)

elements.name: CLST
elements.description: Clay dust. Produces paste when mixed with water.

elements.name: WWLD
elements.description: WireWorld wires, conducts based on a set of GOL-like rules.

elements.name: GBMB
elements.description: Gravity bomb. Sticks to the first object it touches then produces a strong gravity push.

elements.name: FIGH
elements.description: Fighter. Tries to kill stickmen. You must first give it an element to kill him with.

elements.name: FRAY
elements.description: Force Emitter. Pushes or pulls objects based on its temperature. Use like ARAY.

elements.name: RPEL
elements.description: Repels or attracts particles based on its temperature.

elements.name: PPIP
elements.description: Powered version of PIPE, use PSCN/NSCN to Activate/Deactivate.

elements.name: DTEC
elements.description: Detector, creates a spark when something with its ctype is nearby.

elements.name: DMG
elements.description: Generates damaging pressure and breaks any elements it hits.

elements.name: TSNS
elements.description: Temperature sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with a greater temperature.

elements.name: VIBR
elements.description: Vibranium. Stores energy and releases it in violent explosions.

elements.name: BVBR
elements.description: Broken vibranium.

elements.name: CRAY
elements.description: Particle Ray Emitter. Creates a beam of particles set by its ctype, with a range set by tmp.

elements.name: PSTN
elements.description: Piston, pushes particles. PSCN extends, NSCN retracts

elements.name: FRME
elements.description: Frame, can be used with pistons to push many particles.

elements.name: GOLD
elements.description: Corrosion resistant metal, will reverse corrosion of iron. Excellent conductor.

elements.name: TUNG
elements.description: Tungsten. Brittle metal with a very high melting point.

elements.name: PSNS
elements.description: Pressure sensor, creates a spark when the pressure is greater than its temperature.

elements.name: PROT
elements.description: Protons. Transfer heat to materials, and remove sparks.

elements.name: VIRS
elements.description: Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.

elements.name: VRSS
elements.description: Solid Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.

elements.name: VRSG
elements.description: Gas Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.

elements.name: GRVT
elements.description: Gravitons. Create Newtonian Gravity.

elements.name: DRAY
elements.description: Duplicator ray. Replicates a line of particles in front of it.

elements.name: CRMC
elements.description: Ceramic. Gets stronger under pressure.

elements.name: HEAC
elements.description: Rapid heat conductor.

elements.name: SAWD
elements.description: Sawdust. Floats on water.

elements.name: POLO
elements.description: Polonium, highly radioactive. Decays into NEUT and heats up.

elements.name: RFRG
elements.description: Refrigerant. Heats up and liquefies under pressure.

elements.name: RFGL
elements.description: Liquid refrigerant.

elements.name: LSNS
elements.description: Life sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with a life higher than its temperature.

elements.name: LDTC
elements.description: Linear detector. Scans in 8 directions for particles with its ctype and creates a spark on the opposite side.

elements.name: SLCN
elements.description: Powdered Silicon. A key ingredient in producing multiple materials.

elements.name: PTNM
elements.description: Platinum. Catalyzes certain reactions.

elements.name: VSNS
elements.description: Velocity sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with velocity higher than its temperature.

elements.name: ROCK
elements.description: Solid, melts into various elements.

elements.name: LITH
elements.description: Lithium. Reactive element that explodes on contact with water.

elements.name: RSST
elements.description: Resist. Solidifies on contact with photons, is destroyed by electrons and spark.

elements.name: RSSS
elements.description: Solidified resist. Blocks pressure and insulates electricity. Liquefies on contact with neutrons.

elements.name: BASE
elements.description: Corrosive liquid. Rusts conductive solids, neutralizes acid.

elements.name: SEED
elements.description: Seeds. Put on sand and add water to grow a tree.

walls.name: EWALL
walls.description: E-Wall. Becomes transparent when electricity is connected.

walls.name: DETECTOR
walls.description: Detector. Generates electricity when a particle is inside.

walls.name: STREAMLINE
walls.description: Streamline. Creates a line that follows air movement.

walls.name: FAN
walls.description: Fan. Accelerates air. Use the line tool to set direction and strength.

walls.name: LIQUID WALL
walls.description: Allows liquids, blocks all other particles. Conductive.

walls.name: ABSORB WALL
walls.description: Absorbs particles but lets air currents through.

walls.name: AIRONLY WALL
walls.description: Allows air, but blocks all particles.

walls.name: POWDER WALL
walls.description: Allows powders, blocks all other particles.

walls.name: CONDUCTOR
walls.description: Conductor. Allows all particles to pass through and conducts electricity.

walls.name: EHOLE
walls.description: E-Hole. absorbs particles, releases them when powered.

walls.name: GAS WALL
walls.description: Allows gases, blocks all other particles.

walls.name: GRAVITY WALL
walls.description: Gravity wall. Newtonian Gravity has no effect inside a box drawn with this.

walls.name: ENERGY WALL
walls.description: Allows energy particles, blocks all other particles.

walls.name: AIRBLOCK WALL
walls.description: Allows all particles, but blocks air.

walls.name: STASIS WALL
walls.description: Freezes particles inside the wall in place until powered.

gol_rules.name: MOVE
gol_rules.description: 'Move' particles. Does not move things.. it is a life type: B368/S245

tools.name: NGRV
tools.description: Creates a short-lasting negative gravity well.
